evidence_quotes.agenda: 'What are your biggest concerns on this move?' — asked right after confirming availability, before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's stated concern was not being able to carry her couch/bed herself, plus what to do with an old couch she's not keeping; the rep worked through it with her (confirmed the dumpster option, told her to just flag it for the movers) until it was genuinely resolved, not just acknowledged.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Both the estimate-variability framing and the self-prep tip landed clearly ('the better you are at consolidating things into boxes... the less time we take, the less money you end up spending'). No rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Turned a small logistics wrinkle (an old couch headed for the dumpster, not the new apartment) into a fully resolved, no-friction plan, and answered her first-time-mover payment questions with total clarity.
coaching_note: This is the strongest call in the batch and just short of Green — the only real gaps are the missing quid pro quo framing and the Communication half of the takeaway; tightening those would likely push this over 80.
